passives.name: Disciplinary Methods for Jihoon
passives.description: (Passive Effect) At the start of battle, grants an irremovable reduced damage taken to the caster for [Buff_T_tower_very_hard_common_dmg_reduce_single] turn(s). Applies Heavy Strike to all attacks of the caster. Upon taking a critical hit, inflicts an irremovable reduced Critical Hit Chance on all enemies for [Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000008_4_6_1] turn(s), and recovers Weakness Gauge by [Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000008_4_4]. Additionally, reduces Attack, Critical Hit Chance, and Defense of all enemies by 10% each. (Max 10 stacks) When an ally takes a non-critical hit, increases damage taken.
